title: Best hair transplant clinics in Queens in 2026
body_markdown:
Queens has fewer surgical hair transplant clinics than Manhattan, but the options that serve it in 2026 differ sharply in who performs surgery, what technique they use and where the procedure actually happens. This guide compares the strongest choices for hair transplant queens patients — surgical FUE, Sapphire FUE, NeoGraft and non-surgical restoration — with honest pros, cons and a pick for each situation.


**TL;DR**

- Peak Hair Restoration Clinic is our overall pick for Sapphire FUE planning with a surgeon-led New York assessment.
- Hairsthetics in Forest Hills offers FUE and FUT surgery plus PRP under one roof, founded in 2023.
- Luxury Hair Suites in Forest Hills suits patients who want NeoGraft and lighter-touch surgical options.
- MHN Hair Restoration Center in Forest Hills is the strongest non-surgical option in Queens.
- Some Queens clinic pages market surgery performed in Florida — always confirm where the procedure happens.


**Best overall: Peak Hair Restoration Clinic** for Sapphire FUE planning backed by a surgeon-led New York assessment. **Best for surgery inside Queens:** Hairsthetics in Forest Hills, which performs FUE and FUT with PRP support. **Best for non-surgical restoration:** MHN Hair Restoration Center in Forest Hills.

## Why this matters for Queens patients

A transplant is a medical decision before it is a purchase: the cause of hair loss has to be diagnosed, the donor area measured and the hairline designed before any graft is moved. Queens patients face one extra question that Manhattan patients rarely do — some clinics advertise a Queens address while the surgery itself happens elsewhere. This guide reads each clinic's own published information and flags that distinction wherever it applies.

## What makes the best hair transplant clinic in Queens

- **Diagnosis before surgery.** The clinic should identify the type of hair loss first, because some causes need medical treatment rather than grafts.
- **Named surgical roles.** You should be able to ask who performs extraction, site creation and placement, and get a clinician's answer.
- **Donor planning.** A responsible plan states how much donor hair can be used without visible depletion — the [Sapphire FUE hair transplant guide](https://peakhairtransplant.com/blog/sapphire-fue-hair-transplant-guide) explains why the blade is only one part of this.
- **Natural hairline design.** Position, angle and density should match your face and future loss pattern, not a package tier.
- **Location transparency.** Queens patients deserve to know whether surgery happens in the borough, elsewhere in NYC or out of state.
- **Aftercare.** Written recovery instructions and a named contact who answers after surgery.

## Best hair transplant clinics in Queens at a glance

| Clinic | Best for | Standout feature | Key limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Peak Hair Restoration Clinic | Overall Sapphire FUE planning | Surgeon-led New York assessment | One NYC location; travel from much of Queens |
| Hairsthetics | FUE and FUT surgery in Forest Hills | Surgery, laser PRP and beard/eyebrow work in one clinic | Founded in 2023, so a shorter public track record |
| Luxury Hair Suites | NeoGraft and lighter-touch surgery | NeoGraft automated extraction with PRP support | Studio model, not a physician-surgeon practice |
| Great Hair Transplants (Dr. Brett Bolton) | Corrective and high-density cases | MaxHarvest technique; serves travel-in patients | Surgery happens at the Florida base, not in Queens |
| MHN Hair Restoration Center | Non-surgical restoration | 50+ years of NYC hair replacement, no surgery | Cannot address advanced loss that needs grafts |

### 1. Peak Hair Restoration Clinic: best overall for Sapphire FUE planning

**Best for: Queens patients who want a surgeon-led assessment and a donor-aware Sapphire FUE plan.**

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic offers Sapphire FUE transplants, PRP packages and stem cell therapy, with a New York location that serves patients from across the metro area. The consultation is structured as a medical assessment — donor capacity, graft count planning and hairline design — rather than a package sale, and the clinic's published guidance is explicit that a consultation can correctly end with a recommendation to wait.

**Peak Hair Restoration Clinic pros:**

- Sapphire FUE with emphasis on natural hairline design and donor conservation.
- A New York location reachable from Queens, plus an Istanbul clinic for patients comparing travel options.
- Surgical and non-surgical paths (PRP, stem cell therapy) assessed before surgery is recommended.
- Published patient guides on hairline design, recovery and graft planning that set expectations honestly.

**Peak Hair Restoration Clinic cons:**

- The Miami location is described as coming soon in 2026, so East Coast patients currently use the New York or Istanbul sites.
- One New York location means some Queens residents travel, especially from eastern neighborhoods like Flushing or Bayside.
- High-demand assessment slots can mean waiting for the right surgeon rather than the earliest date.

For context on how the borough compares, the guide to the [best hair transplant clinics in New York City](https://peakhairtransplant.com/blog/best-7-hair-transplant-clinics-in-new-york-city) covers the Manhattan-heavy top of the market.

**Best for:** a first surgical consultation where the diagnosis, donor plan and hairline design matter more than the address.

### 2. Hairsthetics: best for FUE and FUT surgery in Forest Hills

**Best for: Forest Hills and central Queens patients who want surgery and PRP in one Queens clinic.**

Hairsthetics, at 71-11 110th Street in Forest Hills (11375), is a hair restoration clinic founded in 2023 that performs follicular unit extraction (FUE) and follicular unit transplantation (FUT), supported by laser PRP therapy and scalp, eyebrow and beard work. The clinic's published process starts with a 30 to 60 minute consultation covering hair loss history, expectations and a scalp examination before a personalized treatment plan.

**Hairsthetics pros:**

- Genuine surgical capability inside Queens — no travel to Manhattan for FUE or FUT.
- PRP therapy available alongside surgery for patients weighing combined plans.
- Consultation includes a detailed scalp examination, not just a sales conversation.

**Hairsthetics cons:**

- Founded in 2023, so the public track record is shorter than legacy NYC practices.
- The practice spans medical-spa services as well as hair restoration, so confirm your case is handled by the surgical team.

**Best for:** central Queens patients who prioritize staying local for surgery and follow-up.

### 3. Luxury Hair Suites: best for NeoGraft and lighter-touch options

**Best for: patients curious about NeoGraft automation and staged, lower-intensity plans.**

Luxury Hair Suites operates at 106-15 Queens Blvd, Suite 20, Forest Hills (11375), offering PRP therapy, precision FUE and NeoGraft transplantation — an automated extraction and implantation system that reduces follicle handling. The studio positions itself around personalized evaluation of hair pattern, donor area and goals before recommending a plan, and markets natural density with no linear scarring.

**Luxury Hair Suites pros:**

- NeoGraft option for patients who want automated FUE-style extraction.
- PRP available as a standalone or supportive treatment.
- Forest Hills location on the Queens Blvd corridor, easy to reach from the E/F trains.
- Free initial consultation published on its site.

**Luxury Hair Suites cons:**

- The studio model relies on restoration technicians rather than a named physician-surgeon, so ask directly who performs each surgical step.
- Advanced or corrective cases may need a dedicated surgical practice.

**Best for:** early-stage loss or patients who want to start non-surgically and keep surgical options open.

### 4. Great Hair Transplants (Dr. Brett Bolton): best for corrective and high-density cases

**Best for: complex or previously botched cases where the patient can travel for surgery.**

Great Hair Transplants, founded by Dr. Brett Bolton, lists a Forest Hills Gardens, Queens service page and is known for its MaxHarvest technique and corrective work on patients unsatisfied with prior surgery elsewhere. The important detail for Queens patients: the operating clinic is based at 2715 East Oakland Park Blvd in Fort Lauderdale, Florida — the Queens page is service-area marketing, not a Queens operating room.

**Great Hair Transplants pros:**

- Dr. Bolton's MaxHarvest and Bolton Bundle techniques, developed for high graft counts.
- A large volume of corrective and repair cases in its published patient material.
- Serves patients traveling from across the US and internationally.

**Great Hair Transplants cons:**

- Surgery happens in Fort Lauderdale, so Queens patients should budget travel and recovery time away from home.
- The Queens-facing page does not change where the procedure is performed.

**Best for:** patients with prior unsatisfactory surgery who already accept out-of-state travel.

### 5. MHN Hair Restoration Center: best non-surgical hair restoration in Queens

**Best for: hair loss that does not need — or cannot yet support — surgery.**

MHN Hair Restoration Center in Forest Hills has been part of the NYC hair replacement scene for over 50 years as a family-owned studio, providing non-surgical solutions: custom hair systems, wigs and toppers for women, low-level laser therapy and extensions. For patients whose donor area is insufficient, whose loss cause needs medical management first, or who simply do not want surgery, this is the strongest Queens option.

**MHN pros:**

- Five decades of continuous operation in New York.
- Full non-surgical menu, including laser therapy and women's solutions.
- Private studio consultations with a hair loss specialist.

**MHN cons:**

- No surgical services — advanced pattern loss that needs grafts is out of scope.
- Ongoing maintenance and replacement costs are part of the non-surgical model.

**Best for:** Queens residents who want immediate cosmetic improvement without surgery.

## How we ranked

The ranking weights diagnosis-first consultation, named surgical roles and donor planning above convenience, per the criteria above. Every claim in this guide comes from each clinic's own published information as of 2026 — addresses, founding dates, techniques and consultation structure. No pricing appears because published prices change and this guide is an assessment of clinical fit, not a quote.

## Which Queens hair transplant clinic should you choose?

If you want a full surgical assessment with Sapphire FUE and a donor plan built for the long term, start with Peak Hair Restoration Clinic's New York consultation. If staying inside Queens for surgery itself is the priority, Hairsthetics in Forest Hills is the strongest surgical option in the borough. If you want to begin without surgery, MHN Hair Restoration Center covers non-surgical restoration, and Luxury Hair Suites bridges the two worlds with NeoGraft and PRP. Patients with failed prior surgery should weigh a corrective specialist like Dr. Bolton's practice, accepting the travel it requires.

One more consideration applies to everyone in 2026: before committing to any clinic, compare written graft estimates and aftercare terms. The guide to [hair transplant cost in NYC](https://peakhairtransplant.com/blog/how-much-does-a-hair-transplant-cost-in-nyc) explains what a comparable quote should include.

## FAQ


**Are there hair transplant clinics in Queens?**

Yes. Hairsthetics and Luxury Hair Suites both operate in Forest Hills, and MHN Hair Restoration Center serves non-surgical restoration there. Other NYC clinics, including Peak Hair Restoration Clinic in Manhattan, see patients from Queens.

**How much does a hair transplant cost in Queens?**

Clinics in this guide do not publish fixed prices; cost depends on graft count and what aftercare is included. Get a written graft-based estimate and compare it against the NYC cost guide before committing.

**Is Sapphire FUE available in Queens?**

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic offers Sapphire FUE at its New York location. Within Queens itself, published surgical options focus on FUE, FUT and NeoGraft rather than Sapphire blades.

**Can I get a hair transplant without going to Manhattan?**

Yes. Hairsthetics performs FUE and FUT in Forest Hills, and Luxury Hair Suites offers NeoGraft there. Confirm the surgeon's role and where your specific procedure happens during consultation.

**What is the difference between FUE and NeoGraft?**

NeoGraft is an automated FUE device that extracts and implants follicles with machine assistance. FUE more broadly can be manual or automated — the surgeon's plan matters more than the tool.

**Do any Queens clinics treat women?**

Yes. MHN Hair Restoration Center specializes in women's non-surgical solutions including custom toppers and wigs, and Hairsthetics treats both men and women.

**How long is a typical hair transplant consultation?**

Hairsthetics publishes a 30 to 60 minute consultation including scalp examination. Most surgical clinics allow at least 30 minutes for diagnosis and donor assessment.

**Is a Queens clinic cheaper than Manhattan?**

Published pricing is not available for most Queens clinics, so no reliable comparison exists. Judge clinics on the written graft plan and included aftercare, not the borough.


## One last thing

In 2026, **ask every Queens-advertised clinic one question first: where does the surgery happen?** Several clinics that market to Queens patients operate from Manhattan — or, in one case in this guide, from Florida. The answer changes your travel, your follow-up visits and your recovery logistics, and it tells you how straight the clinic's marketing is before you ever discuss grafts.
